topic: Das–Mohanty's concluding conjecture, Electronic Journal of Linear Algebra 40 (2024), p. 488
title: Resolving Das–Mohanty's concluding conjecture (ELA 40 (2024), p. 488) on the singular squared-distance Laplacian

creators.name: Wenlin Zhang
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: Both clauses of Das–Mohanty's concluding conjecture in Electronic Journal of Linear Algebra 40 (2024), p. 488, for equation (3.7), hold: for a singular squared-distance matrix of a complete multipartite graph, the positive eigenvalues of its Laplacian-like matrix are one quarter and one, with multiplicities N−t and h−1, and its inertia is (N−s−1,1,s). A rank-one representation gives the inertia for every nonzero-cofactor case, corrects Theorem 4.4(ii) with counterexample K_{1,1,3,3}, and determines the remaining singular spectrum. The same congruence argument proves the singular-input inertia and continuous-family statements of Lucid's MathOverflow question 513954, revision 2.
summary: Written proofs extend the conjectured positive spectrum to every negative-ratio case and establish the corrected inertia boundary, inverse and adjugate formulas, parameter bounds, exact multiplicities, distance inertia and energy, and singular negative-spectrum interlacing. The structured-downdate extension includes singular symmetric inputs and any connected parameter space. Pinned Lean declarations cover the original graph conjecture, the general structured inertia identity, and the original punctured-simplex family statement. Exact rational checks cover all 2,834 stated graph lists, the 2,818 defined Laplacians, all 11 singular examples, and diagonal structured examples in dimensions one through three.
